---
listing:
  - id: index-blog
    contents:
      - "blog/*/*.qmd"
      - "blog/*/*.md"
    sort: "date desc"
    type: grid
    max-items: 9
    page-size: 3
    categories: false
    sort-ui: false
    filter-ui: false
    fields: [title, image, description, date]
format:
  hebstr-template-html:
    grid:
      sidebar-width: 0px
      body-width: 1500px
      margin-width: 0px
---

::: {.index-logo .column-screen}
```{=html}
<div class="index-logo-libelle">
```
